name: friday
description: Your desktop AI copilot for everyday tasks
author: Harald Bregu <harald.bregu@gmail.com>

scripts.dev-linux:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron-vite dev --mode staging
scripts.dev-linux:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron-vite dev --mode production
scripts.typecheck:app: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:mermaid: npm ci --prefix extensions/mermaid && npm run build --prefix extensions/mermaid
scripts.build:videomaker: npm ci --prefix extensions/videomaker && npm run build --prefix extensions/videomaker
scripts.build:tldraw: npm ci --prefix extensions/tldraw && npm run build --prefix extensions/tldraw
scripts.build:coder: npm ci --prefix extensions/coder && npm run build --prefix extensions/coder
scripts.build:architect: npm ci --prefix extensions/architect && npm run build --prefix extensions/architect
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run typecheck && electron-vite build --mode development
scripts.build:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npm run typecheck && electron-vite build --mode staging
scripts.quality:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:main && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:packages
scripts.dist:win: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:win:portable: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:win:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run build:dev && electron-builder --win --x64 && node scripts/package-build.cjs windows dev
scripts.dist:win:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npm run build:staging && electron-builder --win --x64 && node scripts/package-build.cjs windows stg
scripts.dist:mac: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development ./scripts/fix-mac-build.sh && npm run build:dev && electron-builder --mac pkg --x64 && electron-builder --mac pkg --arm64 && node scripts/package-build.cjs macos dev
scripts.dist:mac:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging ./scripts/fix-mac-build.sh && npm run build:staging && electron-builder --mac pkg --x64 && electron-builder --mac pkg --arm64 && node scripts/package-build.cjs macos stg
scripts.dist:mac:dmg: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:dmg:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development ./scripts/fix-mac-build.sh && npm run build:dev && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:dmg:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging ./scripts/fix-mac-build.sh && npm run build:staging && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:linux:appimage: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.dist:linux:portable: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz --x64
scripts.clean: rimraf dist out && rimraf node_modules/.cache/electron && rimraf node_modules/.cache/electron-builder
